headline: US futures point to a mixed open amid tech-led caution as traders await Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic IPO following Asian market weakness
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) fall 0.30% while Dow Jones Futures (@YM) edge up 0.08% as tech weakness weighs on Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ), down 0.90%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2), down 0.36%.
- Nvidia (NVDA) remains a key focus after South Korea secured a commitment for 260,000 GPUs, as investors also look ahead to the company’s Tuesday earnings release.
- The anticipated Anthropic IPO adds to AI-related event risk as markets reassess positioning in recent tech leaders.
- Japan’s Nikkei (@NKD) falls about 1.6% on soft Japanese GDP and weak Chinese activity data, with AI-trade rotation also pressuring TSMC (TSM) in Asian trading.
- European equity futures show modest gains despite overnight weakness in Asian markets.
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat pre-market after raising full-year sales and profit guidance.
- Rivian (RIVN) falls about 1.8% in pre-market trade following a UBS (UBS) upgrade to Buy.
- Check Point Software (CHKP) trades roughly flat pre-market after issuing a weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue forecast.
- Baidu (BIDU), Tyson Foods (TSN), XPeng (XPEV) and Aramark (ARMK) report earnings before the bell, with limited early share reaction so far.
- The NY Empire State Manufacturing Index is due at 8:30 AM ET as the main scheduled US data release, while oil (@CL) and gold (@GC) trade softer in early action.
